bear_case.title: A mandatory hearing still isn't a permit
bear_case.description: Clinch River's Aug 13 NRC hearing — the furthest-along utility-scale SMR application in the country — is only the final procedural step before commissioners vote; no construction permit has actually issued yet. Zero advanced SMRs deliver commercial power anywhere. First-of-a-kind builds historically run over budget and schedule (see Vogtle).

bear_case.title: A founding backer's exit is now complete, and dilution is filling the gap
bear_case.description: Fluor's monetization of its NuScale stake finished in June 2026, realizing roughly $2.43B versus $570M invested — an early insider fully cashed out, not just "signaled" an exit. NuScale is now raising up to $750M more via a new ATM program (Aug 11), implying up to ~82M additional shares at an illustrative $9.18 — real dilution funding a still-non-binding 6GW pathway.

bear_case.title: Regulatory clearance still isn't construction, and construction still isn't power
bear_case.description: TerraPower's Kemmerer permit was a genuine milestone — the first US approval of a commercial non-light-water reactor in 40+ years — yet the plant still won't generate power until roughly 2031. GEV/Blue Energy's 2.5GW Texas project won't reach a final investment decision until 2027, with SMR capacity not arriving until 2032. Multi-year gaps between permit and first power remain the norm across every design in this sector.

bear_case.title: Burn rates are still outrunning the hype
bear_case.description: Oklo's own FY26 guide points to $120-150M of cash use even after Q2's cost-clarity concerns drove Truist and Canaccord to cut price targets; X-energy's Q2 opex rose 156% YoY against 154% revenue+grants growth, with EPS missing estimates. Uranium spot ($86.48/lb) remains well off >$100 highs seen earlier this year. Pre-revenue names are still deeply loss-making while trading on valuations that assume commercial success that hasn't happened yet.

catalysts.title: Clinch River mandatory NRC hearing convenes in Oak Ridge
catalysts.description: NRC's mandatory uncontested hearing on TVA's Clinch River BWRX-300 construction permit was held as scheduled in Oak Ridge, TN, following NRC staff's June safety-evaluation recommendation. Commissioners' formal permit decision — which would be a first for a commercial SMR — is still pending.

catalysts.title: GE Vernova/Blue Energy advance 2.5GW Texas gas-plus-nuclear project
catalysts.description: Agreement moves the Victoria, TX project (two 7HA.02 gas turbines plus up to five BWRX-300 SMRs) into engineering, licensing and safety-analysis. ~1GW gas-fired power targeted for a data center in 2030, with 1.5GW of SMR capacity to follow from 2032; final investment decision targeted 2027.

catalysts.title: X-energy posts Q2: revenue+grants up 154%, but EPS misses
catalysts.description: Revenue and grant income rose to $54.6M as DOE ARDP engineering activity ramped, but operating expenses rose 156% to $164.6M and EPS of -$0.15 missed the -$0.09 estimate. DOE increased its ARDP cost-share commitment by up to $1B, bringing the total to $2.115B for the Dow project and TX-1 fuel facility.

catalysts.title: NuScale launches $750M ATM as Fluor's exit is confirmed complete
catalysts.description: NuScale filed a new at-the-market program for up to $750M of Class A shares (~82M shares at an illustrative $9.18). The raise follows confirmation that Fluor's monetization of its NuScale stake — flagged as in-progress last edition — fully wrapped in June, realizing ~$2.43B versus $570M invested.

catalysts.title: Analysts trim Oklo price targets on cost-clarity, cash-burn concerns
catalysts.description: Truist cut its target to $51 from $55 (Hold) and Canaccord to $100 from $125 (Buy) after Oklo's Q2 loss widened to $48.5M and H1 operating cash use hit $65.5M, with FY26 guidance pointing to $120-150M of cash use. Shares still rallied 24.7% for the week on the first-criticality milestone.

catalysts.title: Constellation raises guidance, signs Walmart's first nuclear PPA
catalysts.description: Q2 adjusted EPS of $2.55 beat estimates; FY26 guidance raised to $11.50-$12.50 with a 20% annualized growth target through 2029. Signed 920MW of new long-term contracts (avg 18.5-yr) including Walmart's first-ever nuclear PPA (176MW), funding a 30MW Dresden expansion.
